system.description:
Once per rest, during a moment of calm, you can commune with Matushka. Ask her a question, then roll a number of d6s equal to your Charm. Choose one value from the rolled results and reference the chart below for the effect:

  • 1-3: You taste a flavour, smell a scent, or feel a sensation relevant to the answer.
  • 4-5: You hear sounds or see a vision relevant to the answer.
  • 6: You psychically experience a scene relevant to the answer as if you were there.
